test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is: **evaluate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word 'evaluate' means to assess or judge the value or quality of something.
 
• In the given sentence, the early trials are being assessed or judged for safety.

Therefore, the correct option to fill in the blank is **'evaluate'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 1)** 'Elevate' **means to lift or raise something to a higher position.
 
• 2) **'Criticise'** means to express disapproval or find fault with something.
 
• 3) **'Dictate'** means to give orders or commands.
